WITH a AS (SELECT login_date AS log_date,user_id FROM haoshen_dwd.dwd_user_login_di
 WHERE login_date>='${start_date}' AND login_date<'${end_date}'),
p AS (SELECT DATE(log_time) AS log_date,user_id,COUNT(DISTINCT order_no) AS pay_orders,
 SUM(infull_rmb) AS cash_amount,SUM(infull_money) AS charge_coins
 FROM haoshen_ods.charge_order_info WHERE log_time>='${start_date}' AND log_time<'${end_date}'
 GROUP BY DATE(log_time),user_id),
u AS (SELECT log_date,user_id FROM a UNION SELECT log_date,user_id FROM p)
SELECT u.log_date,u.user_id,CASE WHEN a.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS login_flag,
 CASE WHEN b.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bs_flag,
 p.pay_orders,p.cash_amount,p.charge_coins
FROM u LEFT JOIN a ON u.log_date=a.log_date AND u.user_id=a.user_id
 LEFT JOIN p ON u.log_date=p.log_date AND u.user_id=p.user_id
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM haoshen_ods.bs_user_id) b ON u.user_id=b.user_id;

WITH cohort AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM haoshen_dwd.dwd_user_info_di
 WHERE log_date='${cohort_date}' AND reg_date>='${cohort_date}'
 AND reg_date<DATE_ADD('${cohort_date}',INTERVAL 1 DAY)
), offsets AS (SELECT 1 AS day_offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 29)
SELECT '${cohort_date}' AS cohort_date,o.day_offset+1 AS retention_day,
 COUNT(c.user_id) AS cohort_users,COUNT(l.user_id) AS returned_users,
 COUNT(l.user_id)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(c.user_id),0) AS retention_rate
FROM offsets o CROSS JOIN cohort c
LEFT JOIN haoshen_dwd.dwd_user_login_di l ON l.user_id=c.user_id
 AND l.login_date=DATE_ADD('${cohort_date}',INTERVAL o.day_offset DAY)
WHERE DATE_ADD('${cohort_date}',INTERVAL o.day_offset DAY)<DATE('${data_complete_before}')
GROUP BY o.day_offset;
